Road, 2026-10-22

Vela. Sky: "also thought we were changing the road to be modern based on testbed?" Yes. Brief 026 and 028 started it on 20 Oct; this is where it stood, and the pictures Sky needs before anything replaces the asphalt (brief 028 done-check 3).

It stalled because the plan and the pieces landed on 20 Oct, the wiring sat in Splice's queue, and the crew moved to fights (brief 027) and controls (041). Done-check 3 was never run, so nothing was adopted.

2. What changed today

  • New kit pieces (tools/decokit/road_ribbon.py): RoadShoulder_Straight_6m, RoadShoulder_Arc90_R4/R8 (pearl band 0.36 to 0.98 m from the kerb face, chrome 0.035 m edges), PaveEdge_Pinstripe_6m (brass, 0.5 m inside the pavement), Ground_RoadSwatch (carries the enamel and pearl materials into the kit). The five older pieces rebuild byte for byte (sha256 equal to kit.json).
  • Generator rule (tools/world/gen/street/roadfinish.ts, 7 tests): ribbon, shoulder and pinstripe along every kerb face (plot edges via kerbRuns, the circus's two kerbs, the median edges), cut at crossings, drives, tram platforms and track ends (stopShort 0.3), mitred at corners; lozenges on each carriageway's middle line, seams across; deterministic, no random choice. Dev run: bun tools/world/roadfinish-dev.ts: 14,075 pieces in 0.7 s (ribbon 3,669, shoulder 3,680, pinstripe 3,749, lozenge 1,095, seam 1,882; 20.9 km of 22.7 km kerb laid, the rest cut at 116 crossings, platforms, drives and junctions).
  • road_tex.py now runs in bun run decokit; use tags for the new pieces in tools/kit/tags.ts; the proposal kit and plan keys in tools/world/roadfinish-kit.ts; draft plan keys plan-keys.json.
  • Board tools: road_board.py renders a slice of the real world export (ground, slabs, kit pieces, masses) at the game's cameras, now vs proposed, day and night; road_board_post.py adds haze (brief 048 exp2, 450 m), bloom, ACES; road_haze_check.py, road_cost.py.

Nothing in contracts/, unity/ or the committed kit was changed. Not the game's render pipeline (no SSAO, contact shade, real windows): now and proposed share one rig, so the difference is the road only. Buildings are masses with ribbon-window stand-ins.

By day the enamel stands out of the haze colour about half as far as asphalt does (150 m: 8.6 against 14.1), but it reads better against the pavement beside it (12.7 against 7.3), so the carriageway still reads as a road until the fade takes everything (all under 7 beyond 250 m). At night the light ribbon outlives the road: kerb line to road is 54 at 150 m, 46 at 250 m, 26 at 350 m. The play camera takes no fog.

No lights, no shadow casters: the lens is emissive and drawn unlit, the pool is an alpha strip 1 m wide. New materials: DK_Road_Lens, DK_Road_Pool, DK_Ground_RoadPearl, DK_Chrome (brass and enamel exist). Combine makes one mesh per (layer, material, 64 m tile), so a view adds tiles x 5 batches: 25 at play zoom, 165 to 225 in third person at 450 m. Not measured on the Air: that needs Latch's rebuild. Proposal for Redline: cull the ground-pieces layer's finish past about 250 m (the haze is 60 % there) to halve the third-person batches.

7. Handoffs and open issues

  • Sky: say yes or change the road; adoption waits for it (done-check 3).
  • Datum: plan-keys.json (roads.shoulder, roads.pinstripe, an RF-1 clause); kerb faces for the circus mouths (r 43 to 51 along each radial road) and civic bay and drive kerbs: the loop is open there.
  • Splice (after Sky's yes): bun run decokit then bun run kit (adds the four new rows and adopts the five candidates; kit.json changes, so bun run cover afterwards); wire dressRoadFinish(ctx, {crossings: strips.crossings, platforms: stops rings}) after dressCapstone in street.ts, items into ground.pieces (kinds road-ribbon, road-shoulder, road-pinstripe, road-lozenge, road-seam); build.ts road surface from roads.finish.byClass; SF-22 world rule; schema kinds. The dev CLI shows the call.
  • Latch (after his batch): look.json road-enamel row (DK_Ground_RoadEnamel, tile 2, tint white) for roads and the circus; no gutter on enamel roads; kerb row to DK_Ground_RoadPearl with a brass hairline (the district's kerb is still granite outside the capstone zone: 11k Kerb_Pearl stones at 230+ tris would be 2.5 M triangles); retire RoadMarkings dashes; map DK_Road_Lens (unlit emissive) and DK_Road_Pool (additive, fade across v) as the crossings' glow; bake the 14k ground pieces by material (KitPlacer.Bake), not 14k prefab instances. Check Pave_Slab: modelled at local z 0.15 and placed at z 0.181 (top 0.331 if Unity keeps the FBX offset).
  • Glint: ribbon state by phase in LightPhase (testbed auto: day a pearl line, evening 0.45, night warm 2.5x #ffe6b5): lens emission about 0.25 by day, 6 at night in my renders; pool alpha 0 by day, 0.75 at night; bloom picks it up.
  • Redline: Air frame time with the finish, and the culling proposal above.
  • Aster: GDD 15 road role is still "pale asphalt #a5a2a8" (amend to the enamel with Sky's yes; noted since 20 Oct).
